newsitem.title: UK: ATHLETICS-LIVINGSTON SELECTED FOR WORLD INDOOR CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-LIVINGSTON SELECTED FOR WORLD INDOOR CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Jason Livingston, sent home from the 1992 Barcelona Olympics in disgrace after a positive dope test, has been included in the British team for next week's world indoor championships in Paris.

Livingston, who turns 26 next month, returned to the track this year after serving a four-year suspension. He won the European indoor 60 metres title five years ago in his last appearance for Britain.
Jamie Baulch, who beat American world indoor 400 metres champion Darnell Hall in Birmingham on Sunday for the fourth time this season, will be Britain's top medal hope.

World outdoor high hurdles record holder Colin Jackson, fastest man this year over the 60 metres hurdles, has also been included along with former Olympic and world 400 metres hurdles outdoor champion Sally Gunnell.

Gunnell, who was carried off the track injured in the semifinals at last year's Atlanta Olympics, will run the 400 metres flat along with national indoor champion Phylis Smith. Smith is unbeaten this season.
